prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that trip where I went from Beijing to Shanghai—still can’t believe how packed the station was.
And then later that month I also ended up in Hangzhou for a bit—pretty sure I overdid it on the lake photos.
After that I swung through Chengdu too, mostly just to eat my way around the city with friends.
Back in Beijing, I remember we were chatting about what movies were out around then—felt like everyone had an opinion.
For the Beijing–Shanghai leg, my friend had already booked me on train G1, and it was under my name, Li Na.
That ticket was for 2025-03-22, and I rode in Second Class—honestly totally fine for the ride.
In Hangzhou, Liu Yang had already arranged the stay at Hilton Hangzhou West Lake, checking in on 2025-03-12.
We stayed 4 nights, and in Chengdu we did that huge hotpot dinner at Lao Ma Tou Hotpot on 2025-03-19 at 19:00—party size was 9.
Wang Fang was the contact for that dinner and used 13836661033, and later in Beijing I’d already bought 2 tickets for "Article 20" at CGV Xidan for the 15:30 showtime—also under Li Na.
